ज्यैष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The month Jyeshtha or Jeyte, (May-June.)
 f. (-ष्ठी)
1. The day of full moon in

. A house lizard. E.
ज्यैष्ठा the mansion or asterism which the moon is in this month,
and अण् aff.

ज्यैष्ठसामन् m. (-मा) A Brahman versed in that portion of the Sama
Veda called Jyeshtha Sama. ज्येष्ठसामन् as above. aff. अण्.

ज्यैष्ठिनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Born of the elder or principal wife.
 E. ज्यैष्ठा,
and ढक् affix, इनङ् inserted.

ज्यैष्ठ्य n. (-ष्ठं) Seniority, age.
 E. ज्यैष्ठ, and यञ् aff.
